headline: Bring detailed forecasts into your home
intro: Connect Home Assistant to AccuWeather with an API key from a paid plan. Choose a location on the map to create a weather entity with current conditions and daily and hourly forecasts, plus sensors for details such as RealFeel temperature, UV index, pollen, and thunderstorm probability where available.
highlights: Create a weather entity with current conditions and daily and hourly forecasts
Use current and forecast sensors for UV index, wind, pollen, air quality, and more when AccuWeather provides the data
Register for an AccuWeather API account, subscribe to a paid plan, and create an application to get an API key

flow.title: From AccuWeather to a home forecast
stages: Choose a location in Home Assistant
